topic: What payload transponder allocation strategies balance spectral efficiency with dynamic QoS demands from ML traffic classification?
consensus_response: Dynamic bandwidth allocation, adaptive modulation, and beamforming optimize spectral efficiency. ML-driven traffic classification prioritizes real-time applications, ensuring low latency. Integration with edge computing and network slicing further enhances QoS, while quantum-resistant cryptography secures slice management.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms in SatCom networks require joint operation of layer 3 and layer 2 to enable effective QoS provisioning.
